CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Alt_Phone__c), "", IF( BEGINS(Alt_Phone__c, "+1"), SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Alt_Phone__c, "(", ""), ")", ""), "-", ""), " ", ""), IF( BEGINS(Alt_Phone__c, "+"), "+" & SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Alt_Phone__c, "(", ""), ")", ""), "-", ""), " ", ""), "+1" & SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Alt_Phone__c, "(", ""), ")", ""), "-", ""), " ", "") ) ) )
CustomField.label: Normalized AltPhone
